probes.rule: Category-scoped events (`tab.created`/`tab.updated`/`tab.deleted`, `category.created`/`category.renamed`/`category.deleted`) target only project members whose resolved permission on the event's category is `view` or higher — the same population that can read the category's tabs via REST.
When a tab is updated or restored, the tab.updated realtime event is sent only to project members who can view the tab's category; members with no access to that category never receive its content.

Category-scoped events (`tab.created`/`tab.updated`/`tab.deleted`, `category.created`/`category.renamed`/`category.deleted`) target only project members whose resolved permission on the event's category is `view` or higher — the same population that can read the category's tabs via REST.
Tab events are sent to the members of the project.

A decline note is stored on the signature record and is visible only to the original editor. It is delivered to the editor by a private fetch — never carried on broadcast/realtime events, and never included when the signature is read by any other path (notably a still-pending request that already carries a decline, rule 10) — and is never returned to other members.
